question: What state characterizes the mantra practitioner when the oblation has been offered?
premises: The agent is a mantra practitioner
The practitioner is associated with five blazing fires
inference: When the oblation is offered, the mantra practitioner becomes one with five blazing fires.
uncertainties: The compound sa-jvalat-pañca-vahnikaḥ is read as describing the practitioner; exact internal relation is interpretive.
plain_english: The oblation is offered by the mantra practitioner, who is with the five blazing fires.
